'''Thurasa''' is a member of the [[Council of Merchants]] in [[Arad Doman]].  

== Activities ==
She is one of [[Graendal]]'s pets under [[Compulsion]] that now resides with Graendal in her palace. She nearly loses an arm when [[Moridin]] opens a [[Gateway]] for Graendal to enter.
